manifest.encoding: ASCII canonical JSON: recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=true, no newline, duplicate fields, floating point or nonfinite numbers
manifest.signature_value_encoding: RFC4648 canonical padded base64 of exactly 64 bytes
manifest.signing_preimage: signing_domain_utf8 bytes followed by canonical JSON of the complete manifest after deleting ONLY signature.value; signature.algorithm and signature.key_id remain
manifest.entrypoint: existing canonical indexed path ending in lowercase .html
manifest.version_profile: uint32 SemVer triple without leading zeros, optional nonempty dot-separated prerelease identifiers without leading zeros in numeric identifiers; max 128 characters
manifest.minimum_shell_version: uint32 stable SemVer triple compared numerically
manifest.capabilities: signed declarations only; this API issues no capability permit

content_index.object: {files:[{path:<canonical path>,sha256:<lowercase SHA256 of exact bytes>,size:<byte count>}],schema:<schema string>}
content_index.ordering: all non-manifest regular files sorted by ASCII path; no omitted or added archive entry
content_index.encoding: same canonical JSON rules as manifest
content_index.content_root_sha256: lowercase SHA256(hash_domain_utf8 bytes || canonical index bytes)
content_index.self_reference: manifest.json holds the root and signature and is never an asset or an index member

archive.format: single-disk classic ZIP: contiguous local regular-file records from offset zero, complete central directory, 22-byte EOCD at exact EOF
archive.path_profile: 1..512 ASCII characters, slash-separated 1..128 character segments matching [A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9._-]*; no trailing dot or Windows device basename
archive.extraction: none; content retained as immutable bytes after one bounded nofollow filesystem snapshot

trust.root_source: externally authenticated operator policy; never the ZIP or manifest
trust.pin: external lowercase SHA256 of 32 immutable raw Ed25519 public key bytes
trust.verification: fixed /usr/bin/openssl pkeyutl -verify -rawin -pubin -keyform DER, fixed Ed25519 SPKI, sealed memfd inputs, 5-second timeout, OPENSSL_CONF=/dev/null, minimal environment
trust.time: trusted caller clock; policy and root half-open intervals [valid_from_unix, valid_until_unix)
trust.revocation: exact (publisher,key_id) pairs; every admission and every local asset response checks current policy
trust.rotation: new key_id required for a new key; strict increasing policy revision and cumulative revocations within one admission owner
trust.owner: admission, policy replacement and asset response require the creating process and Python thread and refuse reentrancy; policy and remembered pins publish in one state assignment

local_response.mime: fixed extension table with nosniff; .bin is explicitly application/octet-stream; unknown extensions refuse response
local_response.content_security_policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; media-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; worker-src 'none'

remaining_installed_obligations: authenticated policy provisioning and durable antirollback across restart
trusted time and independent publisher key custody
engine origin interception without DNS/network fallback on every relevant load path
CSP/CORS, unsupported protocol, worker/service-worker, navigation and cache enforcement
per-app storage partition, version floor, migration, upgrade/downgrade and uninstall
trusted capability approval and app activation
